It describes the tool as a user-mode utility and includes a demo link, usage notes, and promotional and reading recommendations. The page is a tool advertisement rather than a threat report, so no actors, campaigns, or threat facts are recorded.

cffc1054bd8a80c260664ee07cca1d9712635f5b.summary: CrowdStrike adversary profile of SILENT CHOLLIMA, a DPRK-nexus actor active since at least 2007. CrowdStrike assesses it is likely affiliated with Lab 110 within Bureau 3 of the General Reconnaissance Information Bureau (GRIB). Listed community identifiers include Lazarus Group, Andariel and APT45. Stated objectives are financial gain, intellectual property theft, intelligence gathering and destruction; stated motivations are state-sponsored and criminal.

cfa1b91e1d42cd6d86d703f1f4ccf1e27b00340d.summary: Group-IB's DFIR team describes a campaign against CentOS VPS cloud hosts, which it attributes to the TeamTNT threat actor with moderate confidence. Reported steps include SSH brute force initial access, disabling security controls and rival miners, a cron-based payload job, the Diamorphine Linux rootkit, file locking, a root backdoor account, and erasure of logs and command history. The report says TeamTNT was active from 2019, vanished in 2022, and is seen again in 2023 and 2024 campaigns.
